skills.description: Use this skill when you are clearly stuck or looping. The key signal is **repetition**—a pattern, not a single mistake. Repetition can manifest as: (1) Action repetition: making the same or similar attempts without meaningful progress, only minor tweaks that don't change the outcome. (2) Correction repetition: user repeatedly corrects, rejects, or undoes your work (e.g., deleting files you created, reverting changes). (3) Clarification repetition: user repeatedly re-explains, expresses confusion, or shows frustration about your understanding of their intent. (4) State repetition: returning to a previous state multiple times (e.g., same error, same misunderstanding, same blocked situation). When you detect any form of repetition, stop pushing forward, pause deliberately, and rethink the overall approach instead of wasting more attempts.
